name: Path Feature
summary: Warlock Path Feature Seer of Battle Your reaction advantage may be used after the d20 is rolled but before the result is declared. Storm Warlock Your Storm Warlock push increases to 10 ft. Spirit Guardian When Rune Ward protects an ally, one hostile creature within 30 ft has disadvantage on its next psychic saving throw.
